spans.s: नय् vt. 1Ā (pres. नयते) 1. To go; 2. to protect.

नय m. 1. Guiding, leading, managing; 2. behaviour, conduct, way of life; 3. prudence; 4. policy, statesmanship, political wisdom, नयगुणोपचितामिव भूपतेः सदुपकारफलां श्रियमर्थिनः R.ix.27, Kir.v.24, M.vii.159; 5. plan, design; 6. maxim, principle; 7. system, method; 8. doctrine, opinion, e.g. द्योतकतानय, वाचकतानय; 9. a philosophical system.
नाय m. 1. A leader, a guide; 2. policy; 3. means, expedient.
नय-कोविद, -चक्षुस् a. prudent, wise, having political foresight.
नय-कोविद, -चक्षुस् a. prudent, wise, having political foresight.
नय-नेतृ m. a master in politics.
नय-विद्, -विशारद f. a politician, a statesman.
नय-विद्, -विशारद f. a politician, a statesman.
नय-शास्त्र n. 1. the science of politics; 2. any treatise on politics or political economy.
नयन n. 1. Leading, conducting, managing; 2. taking, carrying, bringing; 3. the eye, R.ii.75, Megh.i.9.
नयन-अभिराम (I) a. gladdening the sight.
नयन-अभिराम (II) m. the moon.
नयन-उत्सव m. 1. a lamp; 2. any lovely object.
नयन-उपांत m. the corner of the eye.
नयन-गोचर a. visible, within the range of sight.
नयन-च्छद m. an eyelid.
नयन-पथ m. the range of sight.
नयन-पुट n. the cavity of the eye.
नयन-विषय m. 1. any visible object; 2. the horizon.
नयन-सलिल n. tears, Megh.i.39.

नायक m. 1. A guide, a conductor; 2. a leader, a chief, a lord; 3. preeminent or principal personage, Bg.i.7; 4. a general, a commandant; 5. a hero in a piece of poetic composition (in rhetoric); (he is either a पति, उपपति or वैशिक); 7. the central gem of a necklace; 8. a paradigm, a leading example, e.g. दशैते पुंसि नायकाः.
नायक-अधिप m. a king.
नायिका f. 1. A mistress; 2. a wife; 3. the heroine in a piece of poetic composition (she is either स्वीया, परकीया or साधारणस्त्री). See under अन्यस्त्री.
